text.en:
Section 3 of Executive Order No. 612 is hereby amended to
read as follows
"Section 3. Composilion. - The CMO shall be composed of
the Executive Secretary as Chair, the Secretary of Justice and the
Secretary of Foreign Affairs as Vice-Chairs, and the following as
Department of National Defense (DND), National
Securily Council, Department of Environment and Natural
Resources (DENR), Department of Energy (DOE), Department of
Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Transporlation and
Communications
(DOTC), Department of Tourism (DOT),
Department of Trade and industry (DTI), Burcau of Fisheries and
Aquatic Resources (BFAR), the Solicitor General (SolGen), the Chief
Presidential Legal Counsel (CPLC), National Mapping and Resources
Information Authority (NAMRIA), and the Philippine Coast Guard

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, thig 7thday. of December, in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Execulive Secretary
